name: @park-sang-gwon/google-flow-mcp

tools.name: flow_connect
tools.description: Attach to the dedicated Chrome (launching it if needed), open a tab owned by this server and load Google Flow. Other tools connect on demand, so this is mainly a warm-up and login check. If logged_in is false, sign in once in the Chrome window.

open_url.description: URL to open instead of the Flow home page (e.g. a project URL)

tools.name: flow_status
tools.description: Report browser connection, login state, the current Flow project/scene, the running tool and in-flight jobs. Never touches the page.

tools.name: flow_screenshot
tools.description: Save a PNG of the tab this server owns and return its absolute path. Useful to see what the agent or Scene Builder is showing.

label.description: Short label used in the file name

full_page.description: Capture the whole scrollable page instead of the viewport

tools.name: flow_inspect
tools.description: Snapshot interactive elements, optionally perform one action (click/hover a button matched by text or aria-label regex, press a key, or navigate), then return the elements that appeared/disappeared. This is how selectors are discovered when Flow changes its UI; paste the rows into a bug report. Never generates anything.

text.description: Text to type for action=type (after clicking target/at if given)

target.description: Regex matched against button/menu item text and aria-label (for click/hover), or "media:<tile title>" to target a media tile

at.description: Viewport coordinates [x, y] to click/hover instead of a target (from a previous row @x,y)

key.description: Key to press for action=press, e.g. Escape

find.description: Regex over visible text nodes; matches are returned with their position

region.description: Restrict rows to a viewport region

media.description: Also list the project grid tiles (index, kind, title)

watch_network.description: Record network requests made during the action and settle window (method, status, type, URL)

settle_ms.description: Wait after the action before the second snapshot

tools.name: flow_project_open
tools.description: Navigate the owned tab to a Flow project URL and report how many media items the grid shows. Generation tools call this implicitly.

project_url.description: https://flow.google.com/project/<uuid> (the old labs.google link also works)

tools.name: flow_generate_video
tools.description: Generate one video through the Flow agent composer and download it. Spends Flow credits when auto_confirm=true. Call with auto_confirm=false first: the prompt, settings and reference image are prepared and verified but nothing is sent. resume=true skips the composer and only waits for / downloads an in-flight generation (after a crash or timeout).

prompt.description: Scene description; the tool wraps it into an instruction with model/ratio/duration

reference_images.description: Local image paths attached as the first frame / reference

project_url.description: Project the video is generated in; outputs are saved to that project

output_dir.description: Local directory for the downloaded file (flow_<id8>_<job>.mp4)

auto_confirm.description: false = prepare only (0 credits); true = send and wait

job_id.description: Job to resume; defaults to the latest in-flight job for project_url + output_dir

edit_mode.description: Edit the last video of the current agent session instead of generating a new one

tools.name: flow_generate_image
tools.description: Generate images through the Flow agent composer (Nano Banana models) and download them. Spends Flow credits when auto_confirm=true; auto_confirm=false prepares and verifies without sending. resume=true only waits for / downloads an in-flight generation.

reference_images.description: Local image paths attached as visual references

tools.name: flow_media_download
tools.description: Download one Flow media item (video or image) by its Flow media uuid using the logged-in browser session. Uuids come from flow_project_open (image tiles expose one; video tiles do not).

suffix.description: Trailing part of the file name: flow_<id>_<suffix>.<ext>

tools.name: flow_scene_add
tools.description: Open a project media item's menu and "Add to Scene → Create scene", then open the new Scene Builder view. Returns the scene URL to pass to flow_scene_extend / flow_scene_status / flow_scene_download. Costs no credits.

media_id.description: The 8-char media id of a clip this server downloaded, or the tile title Flow shows for it

tools.name: flow_scene_status
tools.description: Open a Scene Builder view and report its clips (index, duration) and total length, plus whether an extension is still rendering. Costs no credits.

tools.name: flow_scene_extend
tools.description: Scene Builder "Extend": generates a 7-second continuation of the clip at after_clip_index (must be the last clip) with Veo 3.1 - Lite and downloads it as a separate media file. Spends credits when auto_confirm=true; auto_confirm=false opens the extend prompt, fills it, takes a screenshot and cancels. Safe to retry: if the extension was already generated (clip present at after_clip_index+1, or resume=true after a crash) it is downloaded instead of generated again.

prompt.description: What happens next; Flow continues motion and audio from the last frames

after_clip_index.description: Index of the clip to extend (0-based); must be the last clip

instructions: Drives Google Flow (labs.google) in a real Chrome session that the user is logged into. Tools that generate media spend the user's Flow credits: call them with auto_confirm=false first to preview, then auto_confirm=true to generate. Results are JSON with ok=true or ok=false plus a machine-readable code.
